epics.title: User Authentication & Access
epics.description: To provide secure and controlled access to the CRM system for all users, including login, registration, password management, and role-based authorization.

stories.title: User Login
stories.description: As a user, I want to securely log into the CRM system so I can access my personalized dashboard and manage customer information.

tasks.title: Design Login Page UI/UX
tasks.description: Create wireframes and mockups for the login interface, ensuring a user-friendly and secure design.

tasks.title: Implement Login Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint for user authentication, including password hashing and session management.

tasks.title: Develop Login Frontend Component
tasks.description: Build the client-side login form, handle user input, and communicate with the backend API.

tasks.title: Handle Failed Login Attempts
tasks.description: Implement mechanisms for incorrect credentials and account lockout policies.

tasks.title: Integrate Session Management
tasks.description: Ensure secure session creation and management upon successful login.

stories.title: Password Management
stories.description: As a user, I want to be able to reset or change my password so I can maintain the security of my account.

tasks.title: Design 'Forgot Password' UI/UX
tasks.description: Create the user interface for the password reset request and new password entry.

tasks.title: Implement 'Forgot Password' Backend Flow
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic for generating and validating password reset tokens, and sending reset emails.

tasks.title: Implement 'Change Password' Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the UI and backend logic allowing a logged-in user to change their current password.

tasks.title: Secure Password Storage
tasks.description: Ensure all passwords are securely hashed and salted in the database.

stories.title: User Registration (Admin Controlled)
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to register new users with specific roles so they can access the CRM system with appropriate permissions.

tasks.title: Design 'Add New User' Form
tasks.description: Create the UI for administrators to input new user details and assign roles.

tasks.title: Implement 'Create User' Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint for administrators to create new user accounts, including password generation and role assignment.

tasks.title: Develop 'User Registration' Frontend Component
tasks.description: Build the client-side form and logic for administrators to register new users.

tasks.title: Implement Role Assignment Logic
tasks.description: Ensure new users can be assigned predefined roles upon creation.

stories.title: User Authorization & Role Management
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to define and assign roles to users so I can control what features and data they can access within the CRM.

tasks.title: Define Core User Roles
tasks.description: Identify and document the standard roles (e.g., Admin, Sales, Marketing) and their respective permissions.

tasks.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to enforce permissions based on assigned user roles for all API endpoints.

tasks.title: Design 'Manage User Roles' UI
tasks.description: Create the interface for administrators to view existing users and modify their assigned roles.

tasks.title: Develop 'Manage User Roles' Frontend
tasks.description: Build the client-side components for displaying and updating user roles.

epics.title: System Overview & Navigation
epics.description: To provide users with a comprehensive dashboard for quick insights and an intuitive navigation system to easily access all CRM functionalities.

stories.title: View Dashboard Overview
stories.description: As a user, I want to see a personalized dashboard with key metrics and recent activities so I can quickly understand the current state of my CRM operations.

tasks.title: Design Dashboard Layout
tasks.description: Create wireframes and mockups for the dashboard, including placement of widgets and overall structure.

tasks.title: Identify & Integrate Key Metrics
tasks.description: Determine essential metrics (e.g., total customers, new leads, open tasks) and integrate backend APIs to fetch this data.

tasks.title: Develop 'Recent Activities' Widget
tasks.description: Build a component to display a chronological list of recent customer interactions or system events.

tasks.title: Build Dashboard Frontend Components
tasks.description: Develop the UI components to display various dashboard widgets and data visualizations.

stories.title: Navigate CRM Sections
stories.description: As a user, I want to easily navigate between different sections of the CRM (e.g., Customers, Reports) so I can efficiently perform my tasks.

tasks.title: Design Global Navigation Menu
tasks.description: Create the UI/UX design for the primary navigation (e.g., sidebar, top menu) across the application.

tasks.title: Implement Frontend Routing
tasks.description: Configure client-side routing to load different CRM sections without full page reloads.

tasks.title: Ensure Responsive Navigation
tasks.description: Optimize the navigation menu for various screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).

epics.title: Customer Relationship Management
epics.description: To enable users to efficiently manage customer profiles, including creation, viewing, editing, searching, and tracking interactions.

stories.title: Create New Customer Profile
stories.description: As a sales representative, I want to create new customer profiles so I can accurately capture and store details for new leads or clients.

tasks.title: Design 'Add Customer' Form UI
tasks.description: Create the user interface for inputting all relevant customer information.

tasks.title: Define Customer Data Fields
tasks.description: Identify all necessary fields for a customer profile (e.g., name, contact, company, status).

tasks.title: Implement Customer Creation Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint to receive customer data and save it to the database.

tasks.title: Add Form Validation (Frontend & Backend)
tasks.description: Implement data validation rules for all input fields to ensure data integrity.

stories.title: View Customer Details
stories.description: As a sales representative, I want to view a comprehensive customer profile so I can quickly access all relevant information and interaction history.

tasks.title: Design Customer Profile View UI
tasks.description: Create the layout for displaying all customer details, including contact info, company details, and related activities.

tasks.title: Implement 'Get Customer' Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint to retrieve a single customer's complete data from the database.

tasks.title: Develop Customer Details Frontend Component
tasks.description: Build the client-side component to fetch and display customer information dynamically.

tasks.title: Display Associated Interactions/Notes
tasks.description: Ensure related customer interactions and notes are visible on the profile page.

stories.title: Edit Customer Information
stories.description: As a sales representative, I want to edit existing customer information so I can keep their profiles accurate and up-to-date.

tasks.title: Design 'Edit Customer' Form UI
tasks.description: Create an editable version of the customer profile display, pre-populated with current data.

tasks.title: Implement Customer Update Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint to handle updates to customer records in the database.

tasks.title: Develop 'Edit Customer' Frontend Component
tasks.description: Build the client-side component to allow users to modify customer details and submit updates.

tasks.title: Implement Audit Logging for Changes
tasks.description: Ensure changes to customer data are logged for historical tracking.

stories.title: Search and Filter Customers
stories.description: As a sales representative, I want to search and filter customers by various criteria so I can quickly find specific profiles or segments.

tasks.title: Design Customer List View with Search/Filter
tasks.description: Create the UI for displaying a list of customers, including search bar and filter options.

tasks.title: Implement Backend Search Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint and database queries for searching customers by name, email, company, etc.

tasks.title: Implement Backend Filtering Options
tasks.description: Develop logic for filtering customers by status, tags, assigned representative, etc.

tasks.title: Develop Search & Filter Frontend Components
tasks.description: Build the UI components for the search bar, filter dropdowns, and displaying filtered results.

stories.title: Manage Customer Interactions & Notes
stories.description: As a sales representative, I want to log interactions (e.g., calls, emails) and add notes to a customer's profile so I can maintain a complete communication history.

tasks.title: Design 'Add Interaction/Note' UI
tasks.description: Create the user interface for adding new interactions or notes to a customer's timeline.

tasks.title: Implement 'Log Interaction' Backend API
tasks.description: Develop the API endpoint for saving new interaction records associated with a specific customer.

tasks.title: Develop Interaction List Frontend Component
tasks.description: Build the component to display a chronological list of all interactions and notes on the customer profile.

tasks.title: Allow Editing/Deleting Interactions (with permissions)
tasks.description: Implement functionality for authorized users to modify or remove existing interaction records.

epics.title: Business Intelligence & Reporting
epics.description: To provide users with various reports and data visualizations to gain insights into customer data and CRM performance.

stories.title: Generate Standard Reports
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to generate predefined reports so I can quickly analyze key aspects of my CRM data, such as customer growth or activity summaries.

tasks.title: Identify Initial Standard Reports
tasks.description: Determine the first set of essential reports (e.g., 'New Customers by Month', 'Interaction Summary').

tasks.title: Design Report Selection UI
tasks.description: Create the user interface for selecting and generating different standard reports.

tasks.title: Implement Backend Data Aggregation for Reports
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic and database queries to collect and aggregate data for each standard report.

tasks.title: Develop Report Generation API
tasks.description: Create API endpoints that trigger the generation of specific standard reports.

stories.title: View Report Data
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to view the generated report data in an understandable format so I can interpret the insights.

tasks.title: Design Report Viewer UI
tasks.description: Create the user interface to display report results, including tables and potentially basic charts.

tasks.title: Implement Tabular Data Display
tasks.description: Develop the frontend component to render report data in a clear, sortable table format.

tasks.title: Integrate Basic Charting Library
tasks.description: Add a charting library to visualize key report metrics (e.g., bar charts for growth).

tasks.title: Implement Pagination/Sorting for Large Reports
tasks.description: Ensure large report datasets can be easily navigated and sorted.

stories.title: Export Report Data
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to export report data in common formats (e.g., CSV, PDF) so I can use it for further analysis or share it externally.

tasks.title: Design Export Options UI
tasks.description: Add buttons or dropdowns to the report viewer for selecting export formats (e.g., 'Export to CSV', 'Export to PDF').

tasks.title: Implement Backend CSV Export Logic
tasks.description: Develop the backend functionality to convert report data into a downloadable CSV file.

tasks.title: Implement Backend PDF Export Logic
tasks.description: Develop the backend functionality to generate a PDF version of the report (including basic formatting).

tasks.title: Develop Frontend Export Trigger
tasks.description: Build the client-side logic to initiate report downloads when an export option is selected.
